title: 赭黄山坡的晴天
goal: 迁移同一风格到暖色季节配色
scene: A bright ochre-yellow hillside with a single small rust-ochre deciduous tree near upper right; a broad pale beige zig-zag footpath cuts lower slope; distant pale lavender ridge and deeper-purple small shadow accents. White sky, no sun disk, not sunset. Limited dark brown branching, selective short foliage strokes, large untextured sunny masses. No cottage or bench. A restrained original autumn landscape.
decision: 自行设计暖色面积和冷色衬托；保持晴日空气感，不照抄此前秋日田野
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE square standalone original S002 sunlit brushstroke landscape artwork on white marker paper. Transparent oil/alcohol student-marker aesthetic, broad readable color masses and selective natural short plant strokes, sunny light and shadow groups, airy white paper, NO thick black outlines, NO cute faces. No printed words, numbers, panels, color swatches, watermarks or tools. Use only stated approximate hue families, slight same-marker overlap allowed; no smooth digital gradients, opaque impasto or pale strokes painted over dark. Reserve white shapes BEFORE color. No unnecessary microdetail or dense all-over texture. Narrow natural white margins. Composition must be distinct from other scenes. Intended for 16.5cm square marker paper. Stage: D4 independent project exemplar, composition and decisions matter, not necessarily more details than D3. review_note: 自主或专项示意；阶段为目标规划，实际能力需通过练习反馈复盘。

color_review.method: 工具档案相对色系、区域分工、成品与关键图文字交叉核对；非精确色度与实笔验证
